spans.s:
श

ŚA ({#Sa#}). The letter Śa means to lie down and also Śaṁkara. ‘Śam’ means comfort or happiness. (agni purāṇa, Chapter 348).

ष

ṢA ({#za#}). Ṣa means noble, sublime. (agni purāṇa, Chapter 348).

स

SA ({#sa#}). The sound ‘Sa’ means indirect; ‘Sā, lakṣmī (Goddess of wealth and prosperity) and ‘sam’ means hair. (agni purāṇa, Chapter 348).
